title: Google Gemini Integrates with Google Wallet; US Users Can Use AI to Analyze Personal Finances
excerpt: Google has announced that Gemini users in the United States can now connect Google Wallet through Personal Intelligence, using AI to analyze their personal fina
content_html:
Google has announced that Gemini users in the United States can now connect Google Wallet through Personal Intelligence, using AI to analyze their personal finances and receive personalized financial advice. Users can also link bank accounts and credit cards to Google Wallet through the fintech platform Plaid. Notably, Plaid is also the technology platform OpenAI uses to provide financial account integration for ChatGPT.

After accounts are connected, Gemini can analyze users' financial transaction records and answer questions about everyday spending, budget management, subscription services, and savings goals. For example, users can ask Gemini to analyze their spending over the past quarter and create a plan to save $1,000 over the next three months; they can also identify recurring charges in their accounts, spot subscription services that have increased in price, or use last year's gift and travel spending to set a holiday budget for this year.

Google also offers a memory summary feature that lets users view and edit the personal preferences, interests, and goals Gemini has recorded. The feature is available on the web and on iOS and Android mobile devices. Unlike OpenAI's strategy of initially offering it only to ChatGPT Pro users and then gradually expanding it to Plus, Free, and Go users, Google is making this financial integration available to all Gemini users in the United States from launch.

This move shows that AI assistants are moving beyond information Q&A and further into personal financial management. Meanwhile, OpenAI recently launched ChatGPT Wallet, which lets AI agents complete purchases on users' behalf using secure payment tokens. Both companies are accelerating their exploration of deeper integration between AI and personal financial services.
